verdict: ROAS holds at 3.86x, but purchase rate is sliding this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,740.37 on $1,485.36 in spend — a 3.86x return — across 33 purchases. However, the most recent 7 days show purchases down 28.57% and revenue per dollar spent declining, while ad spend held roughly flat, pointing to the top campaign wearing out with its current audience. Site traffic has stayed steady, so the drop appears to be a conversion issue rather than a reach problem, and we're refreshing the creative on that campaign now. Expect stabilization in purchase rate as the new creative rolls out over the coming week.
